pages.text: Altars are deemed as holy grounds and are most commonly located at high altitudes. At their center there is a divine construct, above which floats an Ophanim, the weakest type of angel. It will diligently smite down all trespassers that come close to the Altar. It should only be approached if the trespasser is equipped with willful weaponry.

pages.title: Circular Angel Altar
pages.text: The use of a Totem of Undying at the Angel Altar will call down a new Ophanim.
